title: 第4章 仗剑行
content_zh:
林枫话音落下，整个的演武场突然安静了下来。

就连林海都愣了下，诧异的看着自己的儿子，至于长老席上起身准备离开的长老，此刻又坐了下来，饶有兴致的看着林枫。

而林浩然，阴冷的笑了笑，此刻的他心中正憋着一股怒气，没想到这废物主动找上他儿子林云。

“林云，答应他。”林浩然目光落在林云身上，递过一道深意的目光。

林云看着林枫，他感觉自己受到了侮辱，在家族子弟中他的天赋只能算普通，唯独在林枫面前他能够找到骄傲，因此他每次见到林枫总是乐意嘲讽两声，但就是这家族年轻一辈最废物的林枫，此刻竟说要挑战他，无疑让林云脸面无光。

“你若能接下我三招，我不再出手。”林云走了出来，他要用最残酷的手段击败林枫，让他明白自己有多废物。

“你能接下我一拳，算我输。”林枫摇了摇头，很淡然的说了一声，这种淡然的语气让林云的脸色瞬间阴沉了下来，好像他真的连林枫一拳都接不住。

人群也都一阵愕然，无语的看着林枫，这家伙八成是脑袋坏了吧，竟然口出狂言。

“废物说出的话就算再漂亮，他终究还是废物，逞口舌之利，也只有你这种废物会做。”林云嘲笑道。

林枫笑了，他逞口舌之利？似乎他只说了一句话吧。

“我出手了。”林枫不愿多和对方废话，话音落下，他的身体朝前，拳头缓缓的抬起，随即朝着林云挥舞而出。

“一拳？”林云眸子中闪过一道残忍，没有避退，同样挥出了自己的拳头，他要让林枫知道差距有多大。

空气突然的颤动了起来，一股狂霸的浪潮遽然间出现在林枫的拳头上，拳劲猎猎作响，人群只见一股波浪疯狂的朝着林云压迫过去。

林云的脸色突然变了，因为他感受到了压迫之力有多强，但此刻退缩已经来不及，双拳相碰，林云只觉一股股凶猛的波浪透过拳头压迫在他身上，一浪强过一浪，没有止境。

一声闷哼，林云的身体飞了出去，让所有人的目光凝固在了那里，这一幕，和刚才林海与林霸道的战斗何其相似，林云，毫无半点反抗之力，只一拳，被轰飞了出去。

林浩然站了起来，呆呆的看着倒在地上的林云。

“怎么可能、怎么可能……”林云同样目光呆滞，无法接受这残酷的事实。

人群听到林云的呼声突然响起刚才林枫的话，‘你张口闭口说我废物，我想问问，如果哪天你发现你比我更不堪，你自己如何下得了台？’眼前的事实无疑证明了少年不屈的骄傲话语。

“这还是林家的废物少爷吗？”看着林枫，人群的心中突兀的生出一个想法，能够一拳击飞林云，至少也是六千斤以上的力量吧。

“你口口声声说我废物，现在你连我一拳都接不住，那你算什么？”林枫看着林云朝他射来的恶毒目光，讽刺说道。

“还有你，身为长辈，却也一直将废物两个字挂在嘴边，现在你儿子被我一拳击败，你说我废物，是不是也在说你儿子废物。”

抬起头，林枫又看了一眼林浩然道。

“不过是气武境六重而已，就足以在这里耀武扬威吗？”林浩然竟被后辈指着骂，脸色极其难看。

“算不上耀武扬威，只不过将你父子给我的还给你们而已。”林枫不愿多言，转身离开，道：“辱人者，人恒辱之！”

“辱人者，人恒辱之！”林海喃喃低语，含笑的眼眸中闪过一抹精芒，自己这儿子真的变了，竟还能说出如此有哲理的话来。

林枫回到院落的房间，又开始了修炼，击败气武境五重的林云并不足以让他骄傲，那殴打以前他，将他扔出宗门的林恒天赋就比林云要强很多，乃是气武境八重的武修，还有林霸道的儿女，天赋都要比林云强太多，尤其是林霸道的女儿林芊，据说都已经到达气武境九重了。

还有三个月便是年会，到时候家族在宗门中修行的子弟都会回来，若是不尽快提升修为，下次受辱的就可能是他林枫了。

修炼无岁月，武者在修炼的时候时间是过的最快的，对于能够吸收天地元气的武者而言，十来天不进食不会有半点问题，天地元气，本就是最为纯粹的精华之气。

十天过去，林枫终于走出了自己的房间，长长的呼出口气，十天时间，他已经到达了气武境六重巅峰境界，只差一口气就可以踏入气武境七重。

抬起脚步，林枫来到了父亲林海的房间。

“小枫，在家中修炼不好吗，为什么一定要回宗门？”林海听到林枫说要回宗门有些不放心，上次的事情林海还耿耿于怀，无法放下。

“父亲，有些事是无可避免的，如果躲在家中修炼，父亲一直庇护我，我如何能够成长起来，成为武道强者。”林枫眼神中透着一股坚毅，宗门的力量比林家强大太多，那里有强大的功法武技，还有激烈的竞争，只有在宗门，他才能够成长得更快。

看到林枫眼中透着的执着，林海心中叹了口气，儿子真的长大了，没错，一味的呆在家里受他的庇护，是懦弱之辈的行为，如何能成为武道强者，只是天下父母心，站在他的角度却是有些不舍。

“既然你执意要回宗门，为父也不阻拦你，不过你要注意自己的安全。”林海点头妥协。

“放心吧父亲，我一定会努力修炼，将他们都踩在脚下。”林枫言语中透着强大的自信，拥有黑暗武魂他修炼速度比常人快许多倍，领悟能力也变得强大，再加上一颗执着的心，他有理由相信自己不会比那些所谓的天才差。

林枫并没有带太多的东西，一匹千里雪、一袋子干粮和一些银两。

“父亲，我走了。”扬州城外，林枫看着相送的父亲说道。

“嗯，小心点。”林海点了点头，随即林枫踏马而行，千里雪瞬息化作一道白色的流云，不多时便消失在了扬州城外。

苍茫大地，一望无际，林枫骑在马上，驰骋于天地之间，顿时，一股豪情在心中滋生而出，雄心万丈。

前一世，林枫喜欢武侠，向往侠客踏马而歌，仗剑行江湖，没想到这一世，他也有机会，一人一骑，逍遥天地。

一壶浊酒、一曲情殇、一世尽张狂！

英雄仗剑行天下，豪情踏血染青天！

这一世，注定不会平凡，这一世，注定轰轰烈烈！

content_en:
After Lin Feng finished speaking, the entire martial arts arena suddenly became quiet.

Even Lin Hai was stunned for a moment and looked at his son in surprise. As for the elder who stood up from the elders' table to leave, he sat down again and looked at Lin Feng with interest.

Lin Haoran, on the other hand, smiled coldly. He was simmering with anger in his heart at this moment. He didn't expect this loser to take the initiative to find his son Lin Yun.

"Lin Yun, promise him." Lin Haoran's eyes fell on Lin Yun and gave him a meaningful look.

Lin Yun looked at Lin Feng. He felt that he had been insulted. Among the children of the family, his talent was only average, but he could only find pride in front of Lin Feng. Therefore, he was always willing to mock Lin Feng every time he saw him. However, Lin Feng, the most useless member of the younger generation in the family, actually said that he wanted to challenge him at this moment, which undoubtedly made Lin Yun lose face.

"If you can take my three moves, I won't strike again." Lin Yun walked out. He wanted to use the most cruel means to defeat Lin Feng and make him understand how useless he is.

"If you can take my punch, I lose." Lin Feng shook his head and said very calmly. This indifferent tone made Lin Yun's face darken instantly, as if he really couldn't even catch Lin Feng's punch.

The crowd was also stunned for a while, looking at Lin Feng speechlessly. This guy probably had a bad brain, and he was uttering arrogant words.

"No matter how beautiful the words of a waste are, he is still a waste after all. Only a waste like you can use your words to show off." Lin Yun laughed.

Lin Feng smiled, was he just using his words?It seems that he only said one sentence.

"I'm taking action." Lin Feng didn't want to talk nonsense to the other party. After he finished speaking, he faced forward, slowly raised his fist, and then swung it towards Lin Yun.

"A punch?" Lin Yun's eyes flashed with cruelty. He did not retreat, but also punched his fist. He wanted Lin Feng to know how big the gap was.

The air suddenly trembled, and a tyrannical wave suddenly appeared on Lin Feng's fist. The force of the fist made a roar, and the crowd saw a wave crazily pressing towards Lin Yun.

Lin Yun's expression suddenly changed, because he felt how strong the oppression was, but it was too late to retreat at this moment. His fists collided, and Lin Yun felt fierce waves oppressing him through his fists. Each wave was stronger than the other, with no end.

With a muffled groan, Lin Yun's body flew out, causing everyone's eyes to freeze there. This scene was so similar to the battle between Lin Hai and Lin Ba Dao just now. Lin Yun, without any resistance at all, was blown away with just one punch.

Lin Haoran stood up and stared blankly at Lin Yun who fell to the ground.

"How is it possible, how is it possible..." Lin Yun's eyes were also dull, unable to accept this cruel fact.

When the crowd heard Lin Yun's cry, they suddenly heard Lin Feng's words just now, "You keep calling me useless. I want to ask, if one day you find that you are worse than me, how can you get off the stage yourself?"’ The facts in front of me undoubtedly proved the young man’s unyielding and proud words.

"Is this still the good-for-nothing young master of the Lin family?" Looking at Lin Feng, an idea suddenly came to the crowd's mind. The person who could fly Lin Yun with one punch must have at least a strength of over 6,000 kilograms.

"You keep calling me useless, and now you can't even catch my punch, so who do you think you are?" Lin Feng said sarcastically, looking at the vicious look Lin Yun shot at him.

"And you, as an elder, have always said the word "waste" on your lips. Now that your son has been defeated by me with one punch, if you call me a waste, are you also calling your son a waste?"

Raising his head, Lin Feng glanced at Lin Haoran again and said.

"I'm just at the sixth level of the Qi Martial Realm. Is that enough to show off my power here?" Lin Haoran was actually pointed and scolded by the younger generation, and his face was extremely ugly.

"It's not a show of force, I'm just giving back to you what your father and son gave me." Lin Feng didn't want to say more, turned around and left, saying: "Those who humiliate others will always be humiliated!"

"Those who humiliate others will always be humiliated!" Lin Hai murmured, with a flash of light in his smiling eyes. His son had really changed, and he could still say such philosophical words.

Lin Feng returned to the room in the courtyard and started training again. Defeating Lin Yun, who was at the fifth level of the Qi Martial Realm, was not enough to make him proud. Lin Heng, who had beaten him and thrown him out of the sect, was much more talented than Lin Yun. He was a martial artist at the eighth level of the Qi Martial Realm, and Lin Ba Dao's children were all much more talented than Lin Yun. Especially Lin Ba Dao's daughter Lin Qian, who was said to have reached the ninth level of the Qi Martial Realm.

There are still three months until the annual meeting. By then, the family's disciples who are practicing in the sect will all come back. If they don't improve their cultivation as soon as possible, it may be him, Lin Feng, who is humiliated next time.

There is no time to practice, and time passes the fastest when a warrior is practicing. For a warrior who can absorb the vitality of heaven and earth, there will be no problem if he does not eat for ten days. The vitality of heaven and earth is the purest essence of energy.

Ten days passed, and Lin Feng finally walked out of his room and exhaled a long breath. In ten days, he had reached the peak of the sixth level of the Qi Martial Realm, and was only one breath away from stepping into the seventh level of the Qi Martial Realm.

Lifting his steps, Lin Feng came to his father Lin Hai's room.

"Xiao Feng, isn't it good to practice at home? Why do you have to go back to the sect?" Lin Hai was a little worried when he heard Lin Feng say that he wanted to go back to the sect. Lin Hai was still brooding about what happened last time and couldn't let it go.

"Father, some things are unavoidable. If I practice hiding at home and my father has always protected me, how can I grow up and become a strong martial artist." Lin Feng's eyes showed a perseverance. The power of the sect was much stronger than that of the Lin family. There were powerful martial arts and fierce competition there. Only in the sect could he grow faster.

Seeing the persistence in Lin Feng's eyes, Lin Hai sighed in his heart. His son has really grown up. Yes, blindly staying at home and being protected by him is the behavior of a coward. How can he become a strong martial artist? It's just the heart of a parent in the world, but from his perspective, he is a little reluctant to give up.

"Since you insist on returning to the sect, my father will not stop you, but you must pay attention to your own safety." Lin Hai nodded in compromise.

"Don't worry, father, I will definitely practice hard and crush them all under my feet." Lin Feng's words revealed strong self-confidence. With the dark martial soul, he can practice many times faster than ordinary people, and his comprehension ability has also become stronger. Coupled with a persistent heart, he has reason to believe that he is no worse than those so-called geniuses.

Lin Feng didn't bring too many things, just a piece of Qianlixue, a bag of dry food and some silver coins.

"Father, I'm leaving." Outside Yangzhou City, Lin Feng said as he looked at his father who was seeing him off.

"Well, be careful." Lin Hai nodded, and then Lin Feng rode on his horse. Qianli Snow turned into a white cloud in an instant and disappeared outside Yangzhou City in a short time.

The vast land stretched as far as the eye could see. Lin Feng was riding a horse, galloping between heaven and earth. Suddenly, a surge of pride and ambition grew in his heart.

In his previous life, Lin Feng liked martial arts and longed for knights to ride horses, sing songs, and travel around the world with swords. Unexpectedly, in this life, he would also have the opportunity to ride a horse and live freely in the world.

A pot of wine, a song of love, a lifetime of insolence!

Heroes march across the world with their swords, and their pride stains the sky with blood!

This life is destined to be extraordinary, this life is destined to be spectacular!
